content.location: canonical Work Unit execution-context and Codex persisted session store
items: Work Unit JSON stores exact codexSessionId, revision, attempt, head, resume count and terminal status.
Codex session store owns conversation and tool execution history.
Git owns changed files and commits.
SQLite and external databases are not initial state owners.

transitions: admitted -> running after session UUID capture
running -> resuming after nonterminal exec exit
resuming -> running after same-session resume starts
forbidden: new parallel session for active attempt

items: Every resume uses the recorded exact ID.
Revision, attempt and Git head remain fixed through resume.
Terminal result references session and Git evidence.
New active attempts use codexSessionId as the canonical resume target.
No migration to SQLite is required.
